model_annotation: Figure 6 illustrates the training dynamics of LUFFY compared with on-policy RL. The x-axis, labeled “Response Length,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Entropy,” displays a logarithmic scale, starting at 0 and extending to approximately 1.6. The first line, colored in black, represents the training rewards for LUFFY, beginning at approximately 0.2 and increasing to a peak of approximately 0.6. A second line, colored in orange, depicts the training rewards for on-policy RL, starting at approximately 0.1 and increasing to a peak slightly above 0.5. A third line, colored in red, represents the training rewards for off-policy traces, beginning at approximately 0.05 and gradually increasing to approximately 0.35. Finally, a fourth line, colored in magenta, displays the training rewards for rigid imitation of off-policy traces, starting at approximately 0.02 and reaching a value of approximately 0.2.
